response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 6 (description of Esther)","severity":"critical","source_quote":"Esther was a very gentle, sweet girl, which is mostly what Hadassah remembered her for.","suggested_fix":"Badilisha tafsiri iwe sahihi na isiyokinzana: mfano, \"Esther alikuwa msichana mpole sana na mtamu, ndipo Hadassah alivyomkumbuka zaidi.\"","translation_quote":"Esther alikuwa msichana mlevi sana na mtamu, ndivyo ambavyo Hadassah alikumbuka zaidi kumhusu."},{"location":"Paragraph 5 (pen accusation)","severity":"major","source_quote":"She was sure that Hadassah had stolen it.","suggested_fix":"Tafsiri kwa uwazi kuwa mleviwa au alidai kuiba: mfano, \"Alikuwa na hakika kuwa Hadassah alikuwa ameiba.\" (si \"alimwindikia\").","translation_quote":"Alikuwa na hakika Hadassah alimwindikia."},{"location":"Paragraph 7 (flash-card accusation)","severity":"major","source_quote":"At the next recess she was blamed for cheating on her flash cards.","suggested_fix":"Tafsiri \"cheating\" kwa usahihi (si \"stealing\"). Mfano: \"Wakati wa mapumziko uliofuata alishtakiwa kwa udanganyifu wakati akitumia kadi zake za kujifunzia (flash cards).\"","translation_quote":"Wakati wa mapumziko uliofuata alishtakiwa kwa kuibiwa kwa karatasi zake za kufundishia."},{"location":"Paragraph 6 (song title)","severity":"major","source_quote":"She taught the girls a song, “How Far Is Heaven”, which Hadassah still likes to sing today!","suggested_fix":"Tafsiri wimbo uliotajwa kwa maandishi yaliyoweza kusomwa kwa Kiswahili au nilete tafsiri ya kichwa cha wimbo ndani ya alama za nukuu. Mfano: \"Alimfundisha kundi wimbo, ‘Je Mbinguni ni Mbali Ngapi?’, ambao Hadassah bado anapenda kuimba hadi leo!\" (badilisha awamu za maneno kama inavyofaa kwa Kiswahili).","translation_quote":"Lakini alimfundisha kundi wimbo, “How Far Is Heaven”, ambao Hadassah bado anapenda kuimba hadi leo!"},{"location":"Final figure alt text (ambulance)","severity":"major","source_quote":"An ambulance driving with its emergency lights on","suggested_fix":"Sahihisha alt ili kukadiria maana ya asili: mfano, \"Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zimetamkwa/on\"; katika Kiswahili sahihi: \"Gari la wagonjwa likiendeshwa litukayo na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zimeteweka/zinawaka.\" (tumia \"zinawaka\" au \"zikizua mwanga\" sio \"zikizima\").","translation_quote":"Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikizima"},{"location":"Opening sentence (idiom)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"As a child, you might think you can’t make a difference in the lives of people around you, but that is not true!","suggested_fix":"Tumia kifrazia cha Kiswahili sanifu au idiom inayofaa: mfano, \"Unapokuwa mtoto, unaweza kufikiri huwezi kuleta tofauti...\" badala ya \"Ukitoka utotoni\".","translation_quote":"Ukitoka utotoni, unaweza kudhani hauwezi kuleta tofauti katika maisha ya watu waliokuzunguka, lakini hiyo si kweli!"},{"location":"Paragraph 2 (phrase about second-grade girls)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"the second-grade girls were ready for someone to be mean to, or so it seemed.","suggested_fix":"Tafsiri kwa ufasaha: mfano, \"wasichana wa darasa la pili walionekana kuwa tayari kumdhuru au kumdhulumu mtu.\" Epuka maneno yasiyo ya kawaida kama \"mkasiriwa.\"","translation_quote":"wasichana wa darasa la pili walikuwa tayari kumchukulia mtu wa kuwa mkasiriwa, au hivyo ilionekana."}],"passed":false,"score":65}
